purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Taveta Form 34B final TOTAL row and preserve an internal source denominator conflict without promotion.

sample.review_context_note: Rendered at both 250 DPI (full page 2 of 3) and 400 DPI directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF; the TOTAL row digits are unambiguous and identical at both resolutions. The portal only served this PDF after a home-page + set-election session handshake, and the download reference (form_id 277651) was independently cross-checked against the live portal manifest discovery (scripts/p23/discover-iebc-form34b-manifest.py), which returned the identical single download id for Taveta (portal_row_id ... KILIFI/TAVETA confirmed by name).

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5, and cross-checked against the independent portal manifest discovery in scripts/p23/discover-iebc-form34b-manifest.py), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

row_reconciliation.governed_p23_registered_voters_source: KDA-VOTERS-CON-023-2022 (data/indicators/registry/observations.json), sourced from the pre-election official IEBC First Schedule registered-voters gazette, published 2022-06-21

note: Total Valid Votes, Rejected Ballots and the candidate cells are individually clear and internally reconcile on the printed TOTAL row (candidate sum 27937 = printed Total Valid Votes). However, the row's own printed Registered Voters figure (41062) does not exactly match the separately governed P23 registered-voter denominator for this constituency (41031). The 31-voter gap (41,062 minus 41,031) exactly equals the registered-voter count printed on this same TOTAL row's source page for the 'TAVETA PRISON - 01' polling station (31 registered voters, polling-station code 049292145101401), which sits in a national-facility ward code outside the ordinary Taveta constituency ward series that the governed First Schedule denominator sums from. This is the same genuine printed-total-vs-ward-derived-denominator gap already documented for other constituencies' special-facility polling stations (e.g. Laikipia East / Nanyuki Prison), not a transcription error. Per the extraction contract's exact-reconciliation requirement for registered_voters (mismatch_treatment: unresolved), this row is preserved unresolved and no turnout observation may be promoted from this evidence until the denominator conflict is independently reconciled.
